description: The plot illustrates how performance varies with the amount of context, showing four resource types as separate lines across different values of “Number of Tokens.” The x-axis is labeled “Number of Tokens,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 200 to 1000 with labeled ticks at 200-unit intervals (200, 400, 600, 800, 1000). The y-axis is unlabeled (no units shown), uses a linear scale, and ranges from 10 to 40 with labeled ticks every 10 units (10, 20, 30, 40). The Tutorials series is a blue solid line with circular markers, rising from about 23 at 200 tokens to about 27 at 500, then to about 29 at 800, and ending near 28 at 1000. The Library Documentation series is a red solid line with circular markers, increasing from about 26 at 200 to about 29 at 500 and about 32 at 800, then decreasing to about 27 at 1000. The StackOverflow posts series is a yellow solid line with circular markers, decreasing from about 33 at 200 to about 30 at 500, then dropping to about 19 at 800 and about 11 at 1000. The Github files series is a green solid line with circular markers, increasing from about 28 at 200 to about 30 at 500 and about 33 at 800, then declining to about 29 at 1000.
caption_used: The line plot illustrates the performance of different resources as the number of tokens increases. The x-axis is labeled 'Number of Tokens' and follows a linear scale ranging from 200 to 1000, with tick marks at intervals of 200 units. The y-axis represents performance, though specific units are not indicated, and it appears linearly scaled and ranges from 10 to 40, with tick marks at intervals of 10 units. The blue line representing 'Tutorials' begins at approximately 23 when x = 200 and increases steadily to around 35 at x = 800, showing consistent improvement. The red line for 'Library Documentation' starts at about 28 when x = 200, peaks at approximately 35 at x = 500, and then declines sharply to around 25 at x = 800. The yellow line for 'StackOverflow posts' begins at a height of 32 and decreases steadily to about 15 by x = 1000, showing a significant drop. Finally, the green line for 'Github files' starts at 29 and rises smoothly to around 33 at x = 800, then stabilizes at approximately 33 by x = 1000. The yellow line and green line intersect at an x value of approximately 600. A legend is available at the top of the plot to infer different lines by their styles.
